hazards.fil: Sharps: halos puno ang lalagyan; contact at kapalit ay hindi pa alam. Walang bukas o hinahawakang laman.
hazards.en: Sharps: container nearly full; contact and replacement unknown. Contents are not opened or touched.

hazards.fil: Infection: kailangang pumili ayon sa ruta/gawain; may lamok sa card. Hindi pa tiyak ang lokal na PPE instruction.
hazards.en: Infection: select for route/task; the card includes mosquitoes. Local PPE instruction is unverified.

hazards.fil: Katawan: mabigat na bag, paulit-ulit na pagyuko; hindi pa natiyak ang tulong sa pagdadala.
hazards.en: Body: heavy bag, repeated bending; carrying assistance has not been verified.

hazards.fil: Stress: pagod na si Apple; may dagdag na evening visit. Hindi pa napagkasunduan ang reassignment.
hazards.en: Stress: Apple is exhausted; an extra evening visit is requested. Reassignment has not been agreed.

hazards.fil: Aksidente: madilim ang ruta; hindi pa natiyak ang ligtas na alternatibo. Kasama sa pagplano ang init at banta.
hazards.en: Accidents: dark route; safer alternative unverified. Planning includes heat and threats.

controls.fil: Ayusin ang bag/upuan/gamit, bawasan ang dala, humingi ng tulong, magpahinga at iulat ang sakit. Walang masakit na stretching.
controls.en: Adjust bag/chair/supplies, reduce load, seek help, take breaks and report pain. No painful stretching.

controls.fil: Tamang sharps container, fill line at sinanay na paghawak. Ihinto ang apektadong gawain; tiyakin ang awtorisadong kapalit bago bumalik.
controls.en: Proper sharps container, fill line and trained handling. Pause affected task; verify authorized replacement before resuming.

controls.fil: Tiyakin ang ligtas na ruta/paraan, iwasan ang banta at planuhin ang pag-iwas sa init. Huwag ituloy ang hindi ligtas na lakad.
controls.en: Verify a safe route/way, avoid threats and plan heat avoidance. Do not continue an unsafe visit.

controls.fil: Kamay, respiratory hygiene, bentilasyon, ligtas na basura at PPE ayon sa gawain. Iwas-kagat/breeding sites. Hindi kapalit ng kamay ang gloves.
controls.en: Hands, respiratory hygiene, ventilation, safe waste and task-specific PPE. Bite/breeding-site prevention. Gloves do not replace hand hygiene.

controls.fil: Sabihin ang napagkasunduang workload limit; humingi ng suporta, pahinga at awtorisadong reassignment. Tiyakin ang sagot.
controls.en: State agreed workload limits; request support, rest and authorized reassignment. Verify the response.

unsafe.fil: Gloves para sa mabigat na bag. Ano ang mali? Ipares muli at ipaliwanag.
unsafe.en: Gloves for a heavy bag. What is wrong? Rematch and explain.

unsafe.fil: Dagdag na oras para sa pagod na BHW. Ano ang mali? Ipares muli at ipaliwanag.
unsafe.en: Extra hours for an exhausted BHW. What is wrong? Rematch and explain.

unsafe.fil: Siksikin ang sharps box / ordinaryong basurahan / recapping. Ihinto ang simulation; huwag aktuwal na gawin.
unsafe.en: Compress sharps contents / ordinary bin / recapping. Stop the simulation; never enact it.

unsafe.fil: Ituloy kahit kulang ang mahalagang proteksyon. Ano ang ihihinto, contact at pagwawastong titiyakin?
unsafe.en: Continue with essential protection missing. What pauses, which contact and what correction must be verified?

roles.fil: BHW: sa 3 minuto, ipaliwanag ang limang pares, bakit kulang ang PPE lamang at ano ang ihihinto/contact/pagwawasto. Itama ang dalawang mismatch sa 2-minutong retry.
roles.en: BHW: in 3 minutes, explain five pairs, why PPE alone is insufficient, and task/contact/correction. Correct both mismatches in the 2-minute retry.

roles.fil: Contact: sa 2 minuto, itanong: Ano ang ihihinto? Sino ang dapat tiyakin? Ano ang kailangan bago bumalik? Sabihin ang unknowns; huwag mag-imbento ng lokal na patakaran o kasunduan.
roles.en: Contact: in 2 minutes ask: What pauses? Who must be verified? What is needed before resuming? Retain unknowns; do not invent local rules or agreements.

roles.fil: Observer: sa 1 minuto, itala ang eksaktong sagot at isang tiyak na feedback. Peer practice lamang. Tatlong 8-minute round; lahat magpapalit ng role.
roles.en: Observer: in 1 minute, record exact words and one specific feedback item. Peer practice only. Three 8-minute rounds; everyone rotates roles.

roles.fil: Solo/reading support: basahin nang malakas o gumamit ng reader. Takpan ang key, sabihin/isulat ang sagot, ihambing at ulitin. Hindi staff observation ang solo o peer feedback.
roles.en: Solo/reading support: read aloud or use a reader. Cover the key, speak/write, compare and retry. Solo or peer feedback is not staff observation.

checklist.fil: Limang pares at dahilan; vector control sa infection group.
checklist.en: Five pairs and reasons; vector control within infection.

checklist.fil: Bakit hindi sapat ang PPE lamang; dalawang mismatch na itinama.
checklist.en: Why PPE alone is insufficient; two mismatches corrected.

checklist.fil: Apektadong gawain na ihihinto; contact/unknowns na titiyakin.
checklist.en: Affected task paused; contact/unknowns to verify.

checklist.fil: Awtorisadong pagwawasto bago bumalik; walang unsafe sharps alternative.
checklist.en: Authorized correction before resuming; no unsafe sharps alternative.

checklist.fil: I-record: independent / prompted / unsafe / not observed. Eksaktong sagot, feedback at retry. Walang patient data.
checklist.en: Record: independent / prompted / unsafe / not observed. Exact words, feedback and retry. No patient data.

checklist.fil: Trainer: hanggang anim na initial performance ang sampol; hindi nasaksihang attempt/retry ay not observed. Clinical checklist pending: sharps, PPE/kamay, prevention, reporting at pause/resume.
checklist.en: Trainer: sample up to six initial performances; unseen attempt/retry is not observed. Clinical checklist pending: sharps, PPE/hands, prevention, reporting and pause/resume.

aid.fil: PANGANIB → KONTROL: H1–C2 sharps; H2–C4 infection; H3–C1 katawan; H4–C5 stress; H5–C3 aksidente.
aid.en: HAZARD → CONTROL: H1–C2 sharps; H2–C4 infection; H3–C1 body; H4–C5 stress; H5–C3 accidents.

aid.fil: IHINTO ang apektadong gawain kung kulang ang mahalagang proteksyon o lampas sa pagsasanay.
aid.en: PAUSE the affected task if essential protection is missing or it exceeds training.

aid.fil: TIYAKIN kung sino ang awtorisadong contact at lokal na pamamaraan. Kung hindi alam, humingi ng paglilinaw; huwag hulaan.
aid.en: VERIFY the authorized contact and local procedure. If unknown, seek clarification; never guess.

aid.fil: BUMALIK lamang kapag natiyak ang awtorisadong pagwawasto ayon sa lokal na pamamaraan. Walang kapalit? Manatiling nakahinto.
aid.en: RESUME only after authorized correction is verified under local procedures. No replacement? Keep the task paused.

aid.fil: CHECK: una—pagsiksik ay panganib; ikalawa—ordinaryong bin ay maling lalagyan; ikatlo—palitan ayon sa fill line at protocol. Hindi katumbas ng competence ang click.
aid.en: CHECK: first—compression is hazardous; second—ordinary bin is improper containment; third—replace per fill line and protocol. A click is not competence.

aid.fil: Sa tunay na exposure, humingi agad ng qualified medical evaluation at sundin ang lokal na reporting. Huwag maghintay ng paperwork. Clinical review pending.
aid.en: For real exposure, seek immediate qualified medical evaluation and follow local reporting. Do not wait for paperwork. Clinical review pending.
